translation.entry: 3 bonus symbols on the payline trigger the Knockout Spins. 3 free spins are awarded and any win or additional bonus symbol on the payline resets the free spins to 3. Bonus symbols are collected throughout the free spins and pay according to the Knockout Spins paytable. 10 bonus symbols guarantee the maximum win.
The Multiplier Wild multiplies the win on the payline by x2 or x3. Wild and Multiplier Wild symbols substitute for any symbol except the bonus symbol.
Identical symbol sets on reels 1 and 2 in combination with symbols on the payline trigger the Ringside Rumble. Reels 1 and 2 lock into place and 3 respins are awarded on reel 3.
3 bonus symbols on the payline during Knockout Spins award the max win.

1. Knockout Diamonds is a 3 reel, 2 rows slot with one payline.
2. The game offers several bet levels for each currency.
3. Each bet is 1 credit and the bet amount can be set in the bet matrix.
4. The number of available credits depends on the currently available balance and selected bet amount. Balance divided by selected bet level defines the number of available credits rounded down to full credits.
5. If it is not permitted to play in credits in the applicable jurisdiction, the game is played in currency only.
6. The payline is paid from left to right. Only the highest win on the payline is paid out.

7. A game round starts on the selected bet level when the player hits the Spin button.
8. The game can be played automatically by activating Auto Spin (if available in the applicable jurisdiction). Hold down the Spin button or use the Auto Spin button to set the number of game rounds to be played automatically.
9. Winnings and winning combinations are paid out according to the paytable.
10. Winnings are presented in credits or in the player's currency.
11. Knockout Diamonds is played in 3 modes; Normal mode, Ringside Rumble mode and Bonus mode with free spins.
12. Wild symbols substitute for any symbol except the bonus symbol. A payline of all wilds pays out according to the paytable.

13. Multiplier Wild symbols appear on reel 3 and substitute for any symbol except the bonus symbol. The Multiplier Wilds contains either an x2 or x3 multiplier. The Multiplier Wild multiplies the win on the payline according to the value of the symbol.
14. 2 bonus symbols on the payline pay out according to the paytable.
15. Identical symbol sets on reels 1 and 2 in combination with symbols on the payline trigger the Ringside Rumble mode with 3 locked respins.
16. During the Ringside Rumble feature, reels 1 and 2 are locked into place and 3 respins are awarded on reel 3.
17. 3 bonus symbols on the payline during Normal or Ringside Rumble mode trigger the Bonus mode with free spins. Knockout Spins with 3 free spins are awarded.

18. If the triggers for both Bonus mode and Ringside Rumble mode coincide in the same result, the Knockout Spins will be played prior to the Ringside Rumble. The Ringside Rumble feature will be played when the Bonus mode has ended.
19. Any win or additional bonus symbol on the payline during Knockout Spins resets the number of free spins remaining to 3. The number of free spins remaining can never exceed 3.
20. Bonus symbols are continuously collected during Bonus mode. When the Bonus mode ends the player is awarded the win of the collected bonus symbols according to the paytable. Maximum 10 bonus symbols can be collected.
21. 3 bonus symbols on the payline during Knockout Spins guarantees the max win.

22. The Knockout Spins ends when no free spins remain or when the maximum win has been reached.
23. Winnings during Ringside Rumble and Knockout Spins are paid out at the end of each feature. If several combinations of two features occur, the winnings are paid out when all features have been played through.
24. No bets can be changed during an ongoing spin or in any Bonus mode.
25. The theoretical payout (RTP) in Knockout Diamonds is 96.0%
26. The game has a maximum win of 2500x the placed bet.
27. In the event of malfunction all bets and wins are void.
